name: Mark Antony Krupa
bio: Mark Antony Krupa is a Canadian actor, writer and producer for TV and film.

credits.title: A Free Man
credits.overview: To make a quick buck, a young Quebec worker arrives in Fort McMurray. Obsessed with his ambitions, he finds himself in a difficult situation following a workplace accident.
